title: EASIEST ANATOMY TUTORIAL on XHS?!
description:
Today's video is about anatomy. I've found the easiest method for figure drawing in XHS! I can't visualize 3D, so I found this tutorial very easy to use.
I talked about how to draw the guideline, using references, sketching, and turn the guidelines into a body. Hope u guys find this helpful!

This tutorial is from an artist in XHS http://xhslink.com/o/7ScUv6YDjqV
